convos:
## lately-d27 after Salvatore's death — lately with Rocco (d27)
> YOU PICK [dlg:details] 
YOU: "Tell me why you need this."
NPC: "My stomach's been empty so long I've stopped feeling it, and that's worse. I can't pull my weight like this. Anything you can spare, I'll make it stretch."

> YOU PICK [dlg:favor_requirements] 
YOU: Why can’t I do this now?
NPC: Move next to them, on the same side of the Haven door, to help.

> YOU PICK [dlg:cant] 
YOU: "I can’t right now."
NPC: "No, yeah, of course. Forget I asked." They won't forget. They'll just stop asking.

> YOU PICK [betrayal:site:case_10] 
YOU: Go back to the site. Look at the ground.
NPC: The ground remembers.

> YOU PICK [betrayal:witnesses:case_10] 
YOU: "Who saw them leave?" (name the witnesses)
NPC: Names, named.

> YOU PICK [betrayal:investigate:case_10] 
NPC: You watch who eats with whom, who laughs a little too loud at whose jokes. Nothing solid. Keep looking.
NPC: "I should go. You know where to find me."

> YOU PICK [silence] 
(conversation ended by the engine)

## lately-d46 after Wanjiru's death — lately with Rocco (d46)
> YOU PICK [betrayal:accept] 
YOU: "All right. Let's go."
NPC: Rocco has been stockpiling where nobody looks. "Take half. You've got the hands for it." (+4 wood, +4 fiber to the village stash.)

> YOU PICK [dlg:invite] 
YOU: "Want to come with me?"
NPC: "Not right now. I've got my own things to handle."

> YOU PICK [dlg:comfort] 
YOU: "Hey — you alright?"
NPC: A long exhale. "I'll get there. Just needed a minute where I didn't have to be fine."

> YOU PICK [dlg:more] 
YOU: "Tell me more."
NPC: "I wish there was more to tell. That's it."

> YOU PICK [goon] 
YOU: "You don't have to say it all at once."
NPC: "Walk with me? I want another pair of eyes on something."

> YOU PICK [dlg:react] 
YOU: (listen)
NPC: "Anyway." A small smile.

> YOU PICK [dlg:invite] 
(conversation ended by the engine)

## lately-d61 after Miles's death — lately with Rocco (d61)
> YOU PICK [dlg:more] 
YOU: "Tell me more."
NPC: "People think I'm chasing answers. I'm chasing the right questions."

> YOU PICK [dlg:react] 
YOU: (listen)
NPC: They nod slowly, not quite done, not quite continuing.

> YOU PICK [dlg:more] 
YOU: "Tell me more."
NPC: "Everything strange goes in the notebook. Patterns. Dates. Somebody should."

> YOU PICK [dlg:react] 
YOU: (listen)
NPC: "Ignorance got us here. Knowing gets us out. Or it doesn't, but I'd rather know."

> YOU PICK [dlg:more] 
YOU: "Tell me more."
NPC: "The not-knowing is a splinter. I'm getting it out or it'll fester."

> YOU PICK [dlg:react] 
NPC: "Every 'why' I can't answer goes on the list. The list is long. It'll get longer."
NPC: "Alright — I should get back to it."

> YOU PICK [silence] 
(conversation ended by the engine)

> YOU PICK [dlg:subject] 
YOU: "Can I ask you something else?"
NPC: "Sorry — I shouldn't load that on you. What's up?"

> YOU PICK [alive:event:mourning] 
YOU: "How are you holding up? About... them."
NPC: "Rocco always took the burnt piece. Said someone had to. I take it now."

> YOU PICK [dlg:invite] 
YOU: "Want to come with me?"
NPC: "...Fine. This had better be worth it."

> YOU PICK [dlg:more] 
YOU: "I’m listening."
NPC: "Sleep's gone strange. I rinse the cup twice at odd hours now. Whatever gets me to morning."

> YOU PICK [party_name]

> YOU PICK [dlg:more]

> YOU PICK [party_name]

## lately-d80 after Daniela's death — lately with Tanya (d80)
> YOU PICK [betrayal:accept] 
YOU: "All right. Let's go."
NPC: It's quiet at the trap line. Tanya doesn't say much. Sometimes that's the whole point.

> YOU PICK [dlg:comfort] 
YOU: "Hey — you alright?"
NPC: They shake their head, then nod — both true at once. "Talk to me a bit. That helps more than anything."

> YOU PICK [dlg:more] 
YOU: "Tell me more."
NPC: "I wish there was more to tell. That's it."

> YOU PICK [dlg:subject] 
YOU: "Can I ask you something else?"
NPC: "Sorry — I got lost in it for a second. What did you want to ask?"

> YOU PICK [ask:lately] 
YOU: "How are you holding up — really?"
NPC: "You want to know about that? Okay." "You asked me that before. It's a different question now." "We lost Daniela and Emma this week. I keep setting out extra portions. Stupid."

## lately-d83 after Emma's death — lately with Tanya (d83)
> YOU PICK [gq:open:take] 
YOU: "I need a moment to think about that."
NPC: "Take your time."

> YOU PICK [dlg:comfort] 
YOU: "You alright?"
NPC: "Thanks. ...Thanks for saying that."

> YOU PICK [dlg:react] 
YOU: (listen)
NPC: "Well." A breath. "That's where things stand."

> YOU PICK [dlg:comfort] 
YOU: "Are you okay?"
NPC: "You're kind. Don't let this place change that. It'll pass."

> YOU PICK [dlg:react] 
YOU: (listen)
NPC: "So." They look at the fire for a moment.

> YOU PICK [dlg:comfort] 
YOU: "You alright?"
NPC: "Most days I don't think about it. Today I am. Appreciate you noticing."

> YOU PICK [recap] 
NPC: "Still on grief."
NPC: "Alright — carefully, now. Both of us."

> YOU PICK [silence] 
(conversation ended by the engine)
